options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the region.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on. Partition parameter is also taken into account when used in conjunction with C(pool), C(data_center), and C(region) parameters.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: region_members
options.description: Specifies the list of region members. This list of members is all or nothing, in order to add or remove a member, you must specify the entire list of members. The list will override what is on the device, if different. If you specify an empty list, the region members list is removed.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), ensures the region exists. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures the region is removed.
